entries.text: Azure Synapse and Fabric Warehouse build their `CREATE TABLE` statements with `translate_ddl` instead of per-adapter text rewrites. Tables are always qualified with the configured `[schema]`, and the generated statement is wrapped in a `TABLE_SCHEMA`-guarded `IF NOT EXISTS ... EXEC('CREATE TABLE ...')`. Synapse still appends `WITH (DISTRIBUTION=<distribution_default>)`, now written without spaces around `=`.
